tour.welcomeDescription: Here's a quick tour of what goes where - it only takes a minute, and you can replay it anytime from the account menu.
tour.nav-dashboardDescription: Your home base - recently updated knowledge, team activity, and the top-contributors leaderboard.
tour.nav-knowledgeDescription: Write articles to document what your team has learned (tutorials, explanations, write-ups), and ask or answer open questions here. If it's something your team figured out and wrote itself, it belongs here.
tour.nav-projectsDescription: Track your team's major initiatives here - e.g. this season's competition aircraft. A project is the hub other things (components, tests, failures) get linked back to.
tour.nav-componentsDescription: Catalog the physical parts your team uses - motors, batteries, flight controllers, airframes - with manufacturer, part number, and specifications.
tour.nav-sopsDescription: Standard Operating Procedures - safety-critical, step-by-step instructions like battery handling, pre-flight checklists, or workshop safety rules.
tour.nav-failuresDescription: Log what broke, why it broke (root cause), and what you did about it (corrective/preventive action). This is your team's institutional memory so mistakes don't repeat.
tour.nav-testsDescription: Record test and experiment results - bench tests, flight tests, whatever you ran - with configuration, procedure, results, and pass/fail.
tour.nav-documentsDescription: Upload external resources here - competition rules, datasheets, reference papers - anything your team didn't write itself, unlike Knowledge articles.
tour.nav-bookmarksDescription: Save anything you want to find again quickly - it'll show up here.
tour.global-searchDescription: Find any article, question, project, component, failure, SOP, test, or document from anywhere in the app.
tour.account-menuDescription: Update your profile, switch theme/language, or replay this tour anytime from here.
tour.nav-settingsDescription: Organization configuration, roles and permissions, member management, and backups live here (visible options depend on your role).

general.title: General Details
general.engineeringListFiltersDescription: Adds a search box to each of the Projects/Components/Failures/SOPs list pages, scoped to that page's own content, and auto-scopes the top search bar to whichever of those sections you're viewing. Either way, an active-filter chip shows what's applied and clears it. Turning this off leaves both search boxes unscoped by default - you can still pick a filter manually.
general.productTourDescription: Shows new members a short guided tour of the sidebar, search, and account menu the first time they log in. Turning this off hides the tour instance-wide, including the "Take a tour" option in the account menu.

Members, roles, and invitation codes are not affected. This cannot be undone.

about.title: About Athar
about.whyBody: Student engineering teams accumulate a huge amount of knowledge — designs, failures, standard procedures, flight history, decisions, lessons learned — that mostly lives in people's heads and disappears when they graduate. Athar exists so a new member can search the system and understand not just what the team does, but why.
about.nameMeaning: Arabic — a trace, mark, or remnant left behind by something that has passed.
about.nameBody: The name reflects that purpose: the system exists to preserve the trace a team's work and decisions leave behind, so that knowledge outlives the people who created it.
about.principle1Body: Every organization deploys and owns its own instance and data — this isn't a hosted SaaS product.
about.principle2Body: Articles, components, projects, failures, SOPs, and more link to each other so context is discoverable, not siloed.
about.principle3Body: The frontend is never a security boundary — every request is authorized on the server, regardless of client.
about.creditBody: Athar is built and self-hosted by Lycans AeroDesign as the reference deployment for this system, and shared as open source so other student teams can run their own instance.
